objective: Bona fide non-affine visual transfer: exact partition refinement and ordered search-state elimination in native narrated H264. Two development families with heldout numeric data each, four controls. No single affine topic repetition.

cases.question: Can 2/3 and 4/6 show the same shaded amount?
Can 1/4 and 3/12 show the same shaded amount?
Find the leftmost index of 8 in [1, 3, 5, 8, 8, 8, 11, 16].
Find the leftmost index of 7 in [0, 2, 4, 7, 7, 9, 14, 19, 23].
Why are noble gases chemically inert?
Why did the Industrial Revolution begin in Britain?
Can 2/3 and 3/5 show the same shaded amount?
Find the leftmost index of 8 in [3, 8, 1, 8, 5].

claims.fraction: Both bars represent one equal-sized whole. Subdivision retains shaded geometric length; original shaded n/d and refined shaded nk/dk are verified equal by Fraction equality and V3-49 claim hashes.
claims.search: Each comparison uses independently replayed V3-05 LEFTMOST trace; low/high/mid and discarded portion physically update on screen. Candidate tracking for duplicate target and terminal leftmost answer must match stdlib bisect_left.

acceptance.per_native: Real eSpeak PCM audio, native pinned Docker Manim 1280x720 15fps H264/AAC, strict mux <=3 surplus frames, full decoded video, at least two distinct visible semantic states from actual frame witnesses.
acceptance.negative: Invalid source family, non-equivalent fraction, unsorted array, altered V3-05 trace/claim SHA, missing semantic animation, source model spoof, scene overflow or illegitimate unsupported renderer must fail closed.
comparators: V3-87 existing affine baseline retained unchanged
V3-05 verified Binary Search state contract
acceptance.revision_protocol: If native QA fails, inspect actual failed MP4 and repair generator or phase-appropriate witness, never change prereg cases or loosen frame/audio integrity.

independent_human_review.method: masked source-family clips, blinded prompt/user ratings
